Chickpea “Tuna” Recipe 
vegetarian | meal prep friendly | high protein | low fat | lunch box friendly

Nutrition: 
C: 41 | F: 3 | P: 15
Calories: 240 per serve
Serves 2 hungry adults, can be split into 3 portions as well

As always, if you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, leave a comment and i will respond to help you out <3 

Ingredients: 
100 grams chickpeas soaked overnight then pressure cookered for 30 minuts till super soft
2 pickle (gerkin) diced
1 diced onion, pickling is optional, it will make the mix more sour though so work accordingly
5-6 jalapeños, chopped
1/4 cup Greek yogurt + more if needed for a creamier texture
1 tbsp maggi hot and sweet sauce OR 1 tsp tobassco
Salt + pepper

Method: 
add the chickpeas to a bowl and using a fork, mash together, you can mash as much or as little as you want, i do it fully to get a creamier consistency 
add in all the ingredients to this and mix together 

to serve: Sourdough Bread OR Lettuce Cups 

pro tip: 
add in another 1/2 cup greek yogurt to make it a great dip consistency
to make this recipe completely plant based, use vegan yogurt
